scope: Exact source request outputs, diagnostic relink, profiles, source audits, failed diagnostic preparation/build methods, closure/pruning and read-only alias receipts. Content-identical files share one archive payload. External inputs/images/oracles are preserved by the pinned prerequisite capsules; system toolchain remains external. No production promotion.
restore: Read INDEX.json, verify each payload SHA256/bytes, then restore each alias only into an absent path and apply its saved mode. Never overwrite frozen artifacts.
